about.heading: Precision in business. Devotion in life.
body: I'm a Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) and Certified General Accountant (CGA), qualified in Canada, with internationally recognized credentials and over 15 years of experience in financial accounting and strategic leadership. I also hold the ACCA (UK), and completed my MBA in England and M.Com & B.Com in India.

As Founder & CEO of Santo Catholic Mission, I've built a global Catholic media apostolate carrying prayer and inspiration to the world in more than ten languages. Yet the truest part of who I am is my faith: nourished daily by the Holy Eucharist, the Holy Rosary, and Eucharistic Adoration. I begin each day with the Rosary in hand, and I share my story simply as a witness — in the hope that one life given to God might encourage another.

quote.text: I dream to live, and live to inspire — and my mission is to bring faith to everyone.
quote.name: John Jofin

dimensions.heading: Three roles. One purpose.
dimensions.lead: Profession, mission, and faith — three dimensions of a life guided by purpose.

cards.title: Chartered Professional Accountant
cards.body: Fifteen-plus years in financial control, analysis, and advisory — internationally qualified across Canada, the UK, and India.

cards.title: Founder & CEO
cards.body: Leading Santo Catholic Mission — faith-technology carrying prayer and inspiration to believers in more than ten languages.

cards.title: Faith Witness
cards.body: A life rooted in the Holy Eucharist, the Rosary, and Adoration — sharing my story so that faith and purpose may encourage others.

faith.heading: A promise made at seven, kept for a lifetime.
faith.quote: When I was seven years old, I knelt before Our Lady with my grandmother's rosary and made a promise to the Infant Jesus and the Holy Mother: that if they guided me in life, I would tell the whole world about them. That promise has shaped every day since — my work, my mission, and my every breath are dedicated to keeping it.
faith.motto: Ad Jesum per Mariam — To Jesus, through Mary
faith.motto_note: The promise of a seven-year-old, kept through a lifetime — sustained each day by three devotions.

cards.title: The Holy Eucharist
cards.body: The source and summit of my life — I strive to receive Our Lord in Holy Communion as often as each day allows.

cards.title: The Holy Rosary
cards.body: Carried with me always. I begin every day in the hands of the Blessed Mother, one decade at a time.

cards.title: Eucharistic Adoration
cards.body: Quiet hours before the Blessed Sacrament, where the heart is stilled, renewed, and made ready for the day.

spiritual.heading: Holy Mother & Me
spiritual.subtitle: Alongside the Mother
spiritual.quote: “My life, my breath, my every moment — for my Jesus and His Holy Mother.”

image.alt: A golden monstrance holding the Blessed Sacrament, lit by candlelight during Eucharistic Adoration

journey.heading: Professional journey
journey.lead: Internationally qualified — 15+ years across financial accounting, strategic management, and academic research.
journey.summary: Canadian Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) with international training and experience in accounting, business administration, strategic leadership, and business development. A proactive leader with strengths in communication and collaboration — adept at managing concurrent objectives to promote efficiency and influence positive outcomes.

resume.title: Professional Resume
resume.body: A complete overview of my professional experience, education, qualifications, and credentials.

bullets: Initiated Santo — a Catholic prayer & meditation app distributing Catholic media in more than ten languages.
Devised the organizational vision, mission, and foundational structure for early growth.
Coordinated with clergy, ministries, and technology partners worldwide to source content across the globe.
Secured start-up funding and provided organizational leadership on long-term strategy and policy.
Prepared and reported financial statements, budgets, and forecast models for stakeholders.
Performed internal audits to assure compliance with internal controls and GAAP.
Managed cash flow, forecasting, working capital, and KPI analysis alongside the CEO.
Analyzed financial data to identify trends and compiled insights into management reports.
Prepared monthly statements, budgets, forecasts, and KPI reviews.
Commodity & Stocks Dealer — Anand Rathi, India
Bank Teller — TD Canada Trust, Canada
